title: Jobs Board Scraper: Indeed, Reed, Adzuna, RemoteOK & More — Input

keyword.title: Job Role Preset
keyword.description: Pick a common role or choose 'Custom' and type your own below

custom_keyword.title: Custom Keyword
custom_keyword.description: Type your own search keyword here. Overrides the preset above when filled in.

searchTerms.title: Extra Search Terms (multi-search)
searchTerms.description: Search several roles at once. Each term is searched separately and the results are merged and deduplicated into one dataset. Leave empty to just use the keyword above. Example: ["software engineer", "backend developer", "platform engineer"].

location.title: Location Preset
location.description: Pick a common location or choose 'Custom' and type your own below

custom_location.title: Custom Location
custom_location.description: Type your own location here. Overrides the preset above when filled in.

country.title: Country / Region
country.description: Target country for job search. Determines which boards are auto-selected.
enumTitles: 🇬🇧 United Kingdom (Reed, Totaljobs, CV-Library, CWJobs, Indeed UK, FindAJob, Adzuna, The Muse)
🇺🇸 United States (USAJobs, Indeed US, Adzuna, RemoteOK, The Muse, Remotive)
🇩🇪 Germany (Indeed DE, Adzuna, Arbeitnow, The Muse)
🌍 Remote / Global (RemoteOK, Arbeitnow, Remotive, Jobicy, The Muse, Adzuna)

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum total job listings to return (spread across all boards). Minimum 100. Billing is per row, so the run also stops at whatever your 'Maximum cost per run' setting covers; raise that limit when starting the Actor if you want more rows than it allows.

unlimited.title: Unlimited Mode
unlimited.description: Scrape without a results cap. Results are saved as they come in, so you keep everything even if you stop the run early. Overrides Max Results.

salary_min.title: Minimum Salary
salary_min.description: Minimum annual salary filter (e.g. 30000, 50000, 75000). Leave empty for no filter.
salary_min.sectionDescription: Narrow down your job search results

job_type.title: Contract Type (per-board filter)
job_type.description: Employment filter sent straight to the boards that support it (Reed, Indeed, Adzuna, GOV.UK Find a Job). Leave on 'All Types' to let the Job Type filter below handle it across every board.

jobType.title: Job Type
jobType.description: Normalized job-type filter applied across every board. Boards that expose a type are filtered on it; where they don't, the type is inferred from the title/description. Jobs whose type can't be determined are kept.

remoteOnly.title: Remote Only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only remote roles. Detected from the location, title and source board (remote-first boards are always remote).

postedWithinHours.title: Posted Within (hours)
postedWithinHours.description: Only keep jobs posted within this many hours (e.g. 24 = last day, 168 = last week). Jobs with no readable post date are kept. Leave empty for no date filter.

radiusMiles.title: Search Radius (miles)
radiusMiles.description: Widen the search around your location by this many miles. Passed to boards that support a radius (Indeed, Adzuna); ignored by boards that don't. Leave empty for each board's default.

boards.title: Job Boards to Scrape
boards.description: Pick specific boards or leave empty to auto-select based on your chosen country. Cost tip: the free-API boards (RemoteOK, Arbeitnow, The Muse, Remotive, Jobicy, Adzuna, USAJobs) need no browser or proxy — a run using only these is the cheapest and can be run at 1024 MB memory.
boards.sectionDescription: Pick specific boards or leave empty to auto-select based on your chosen country

deduplicate.title: Remove Duplicates
deduplicate.description: Merge duplicate jobs that appear on multiple boards into one record citing every source. Identical listings (same board, same URL) found by more than one search term are always returned only once, even with this off.

salary_benchmark.title: Include Salary Benchmarks
salary_benchmark.description: Output salary summary statistics (median, mean, p25, p75) alongside job listings

descriptionFormat.title: Description Format
descriptionFormat.description: Format of the job `description` field: Markdown (default), raw HTML, or plain text.

resolveApplyUrl.title: Resolve Real Apply URL (slower)
resolveApplyUrl.description: Follow redirects on aggregator links to reveal the real company/ATS apply URL (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby…) and detect the ATS more often. Off by default because it adds a network request per job — leave off for the cheapest runs.

incrementalOnly.title: Incremental Mode (new jobs only)
incrementalOnly.description: For scheduled/recurring runs: remember jobs seen in previous runs of the same search and push ONLY jobs that are new since last time. The first run returns everything and starts the memory. Great for daily/weekly job alerts.

reed_api_key.title: Reed API Key
reed_api_key.description: Optional: free key from https://www.reed.co.uk/developers. When set, Reed is read through its official JSON API (100 results per request, includes descriptions, never blocked, no proxy) instead of its web pages.
reed_api_key.sectionDescription: A free Reed API key makes the biggest UK board cheaper and more complete

adzuna_app_id.title: Adzuna App ID
adzuna_app_id.description: Optional: Adzuna API App ID (free at https://developer.adzuna.com)
adzuna_app_id.sectionDescription: Register for free API keys at https://developer.adzuna.com to enable Adzuna scraping

usajobs_api_key.title: USAJobs API Key
usajobs_api_key.description: Optional: USAJobs API key (free at https://developer.usajobs.gov). Required for the USAJobs board — without it the board is skipped.
usajobs_api_key.sectionDescription: Register for a free API key at https://developer.usajobs.gov to enable the USAJobs board

usajobs_email.title: USAJobs Email
usajobs_email.description: Optional: the email address your USAJobs API key was issued to (sent as the User-Agent header on USAJobs API requests).

max_pages_per_board.title: Max pages per board
max_pages_per_board.description: Hard cap on search pages fetched per board and search term (25-50 listings per page). Mainly bounds Unlimited Mode.

proxy_mode.title: Proxy
proxy_mode.description: Residential proxies (default) are the most reliable for the UK job boards and GOV.UK. Datacenter is cheaper but more often blocked. 'None' disables proxies entirely. API boards never use a proxy.
